title: Community Resources and Referrals
tagline: No counselor is an island; the community is the team.
welcome: A counselor who knows the community can open any door a child needs. This course maps the ecosystem and trains the referral craft.
vignette: A family needs housing, a pediatric psychiatrist, and a food basket, all this week. The counselor's resource map turns three crises into three appointments. Referral skill is hope made logistical.
vignette_attr: A multi-need family, drawn from practice
description: A course in the community ecosystem around children and families: mapping mental health, medical, educational, social, and faith resources; the warm referral craft; case coordination and follow-through; cultural and access considerations; and building referral networks.
questions: What exists in this community for this child?
How do I make a referral a family will actually keep?
How do I coordinate without dropping the thread?
importance: Most child needs exceed one professional
Warm referrals dramatically increase kept appointments
Coordination prevents children falling between services
misconceptions: that referral is passing the buck, when it is an act of care
that knowing resources is optional, when it is core competence
figures: whose maps you will inherit and extend
outcomes: You will inventory mental health, medical, and social resources.
You will craft referrals families keep.
You will hold the thread across agencies.
You will match resources to family reality.
You will cultivate reciprocal professional relationships.
You will close the loop responsibly.
practicum: A community resource map of your area
tips: Keep a living, dated resource map
Do the first booking with the family present
Follow up every referral within two weeks
integration: Referral competence completes your clinical reach across every setting.
faith: We are members of one another; the community is the body that carries the child.
closing: May your map be rich and your handoffs warm, and may no child be left between doors.
